off.title: Track rent for this lease
off.body: We post each month's rent, apply the lease's late fee, and you send receipts to the tenant in their language.
off.notSigned: Available once the lease is signed.
off.noPolicy: The lease has no late fee.
off.policyGrace: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} grace

entries.title: Activity
entries.empty: No activity yet. Rent posts 5 days before each due date.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.description: For cash, check, ATH Móvil or bank transfers you received directly.
payment.referenceHint: Check number or ATH Móvil confirmation number.
payment.sendReceipt: Email a receipt to the tenant
payment.noEmail: The tenant has no email; you can download the receipt.

charge.title: Add charge
charge.description: Charges other than monthly rent: repairs, utilities, keys.

void.title: Void entry
void.body: The entry stays in the history as voided and no longer counts toward the balance.

overview.title: Rent
overview.description: Rent across all your leases: expected, collected and overdue.
overview.emptyBody: Open a signed lease and turn on “Rent and payments”.

ath.title: ATH Móvil Business
ath.body: Your tenants pay rent with ATH Móvil from their portal. The money goes straight to your ATH Business account; ContractOS never touches it. Every confirmed payment is posted to the rent ledger and the tenant gets a receipt.
ath.step1: Open the ATH Business app on your phone.
ath.step2: Go to Settings (Configuración) → API Integration (Integración con API).
ath.step3: Paste the public token here. The private token is optional: it is only needed for refunds.
ath.businessNameHint: For example, your business name in ATH Business.
ath.privateTokenHint: Only for refunds. Stored encrypted and never shown.
ath.noSandbox: ATH Móvil has no test environment: a tenant's first real payment is the test. We suggest asking one tenant to pay $1 first and checking that it reaches your account.
ath.security: We store the tokens encrypted. You can disconnect ATH Móvil at any time.
ath.disconnectBody: Your tenants will no longer see “Pay with ATH Móvil”. Payments already recorded stay in the rent ledger.
